text:
Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz

​
Introduction
Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz is a stalker boss located in the Wilderness and requires 40  to fight. Unlike other stalker creatures, 71  is not required. This encounter is aimed at lower levels and introduces movement as a mechanic which players must react to and avoid.
​
Attack Rotation
3  auto → 3x3  square → 4  auto → 3x waves → 4  auto
​
3x3  square → 4  auto → 3x waves → 4  auto → minions → repeat
​
Notes:
⬥ Bar fills up per each auto, Mhekarnahz does a mechanic when bar is full
⬥ After minions it will be 4  autos
​
Mechanics



















Auto-attack
⬥ Does 4  auto-attacks between mechanics
    • The start of the encounter only has 3
    • Click to view an example of the auto-attack
Targeted 3x3 Square
⬥ Shoots a 3x3 attack towards the player that inflicts  damage
    • Getting hit will cause a short  and 
    • Click to view an example of the targeted 3x3 square
Waves
⬥ Unleashes 3 consecutive waves which cover specific parts of the arena
    • They occur back-to-back in a random order and deal typeless damage
    • They cover the outer, middle, and inner sections of the arena respectively
    • Click to view an example of the 3 waves
Minions
⬥ Spawns 3 warped flesh sacs with bars above their heads
    • If a bar fills, spawns a warped seeker
    • Boss is immune while minions are alive
    • Click to view an example of the minions








Presets
⬥ Melee - Resetting 
⬥ Ranged - Instance Camp 
⬥ Magic - Instance Camp 
⬥ Melee - Instance Camp 
​

All listed strategies use  +  + the style's respective stat-boosting prayer. May replace with  curses but could result in slightly less consistent kills per hour.
